run_continue_training_cifar10: run the continue_train script to resume training a loaded CIFAR-10 NAS model from a checkpoint
run_infer_validation: run the infer function to evaluate a model on a validation data loader and return accuracy
run_train_epoch: run the train function to train a model for one epoch on a training data loader
run_main_training_loop: run the main function to load a model and continue training with cosine annealing LR schedule
run_model_evaluation: run the continue_train script with a saved model path to evaluate and save the best accuracy
